title: Fixed formulas showing a rejected or pending value, the editor closing on another cell's validation, a header sort running before a pending edit landed, and sorting, moving, pending edits, and sort state on grids built from a HyperFormula sheet, a sort after enabling formulas on a live grid, and `updateSettings({ data, formulas })` showing formulas as text. A change to a cell with a validator and `allowInvalid: false` now reaches HyperFormula after validation, so `afterFormulasValuesUpdate` fires then, and a reload through `updateSettings()` of a grid built from a HyperFormula sheet fires `afterUpdateData` instead of `afterLoadData` and `afterChange` with the `'updateData'` source instead of `'loadData'`.
